text.title: Sunken Citadel
text.body: A half-drowned imperial fortress carved into sea-caves blocks the coastal aqueducts to Harborwatch. Breach the ballista-lined outer ramparts, brace against knee-deep brine and submerged skeletal spearmen, and topple the barnacle-encrusted Citadel Warden.
text.obj.1: Defeat the Citadel Warden inside the drowned keep
text.msg.1: The main breach is swept by ballistas and shieldbearers, though a western postern opens across the tidal pools. Watch the dark brine—submerged hollow-guards lurk beneath the water!
text.msg.2: The outer gate garrison breaks before our push; pried open in the breach lies the siege payroll of eight hundred gold florins!
text.msg.3: Salt-crusted bells toll inside the flooded courtyard—submerged spearmen and the inner guard surge from the tide!
text.msg.4: The Citadel Warden crashes into the black brine, unsealing the subterranean sea-galleries to Harborwatch!
text.npc.sapper: Keep mages and archers clear of the deep tide-pools outside the wall; knee-deep brine slows every stride and hides barnacled spearmen waiting to drag fighters down.
text.win: The Sunken Citadel is purged and the sea-galleries to Harborwatch's riverlocks stand open.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell inside the Sunken Citadel.
